September 15, 2026


Cameco was proud to return as presenting sponsor of the 5th annual KidSport Pancake Breakfast, which is flipping barriers into opportunities for young people to enjoy the confidence, friendships and opportunities that come with organized sport. It was awesome to welcome students to our tent, hand out giveaways and connect with the community, alongside Cameco senior vice-presidents Liam Mooney and Rachelle Girard, in a morning of fun, flapjacks and fellowship. Here's to helping more kids get off the sidelines and into the game. 🏒⚽🏀
